newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index little changed.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index little changed.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was up 0.05 point, or 0.07 percent, at 67.64 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index closed 44.40 points, or 1.48 percent, down at a provisional 2950.58 points.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 16.22 percent after 14.19 percent on Monday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
